Ping : -> Ping is used for Test network connectivity -> Test Network Interface Card -> Test DNS name resolution issues
Ping Protocol: -> Ping Uses ICMP Protocol ( Internet Control Messaging Protocol ) -> It is a Layer 3 Protocol
Process: -> First our system will send the 4 packets to the server. -> Second the server will reply to all 4 packets and sent to our system.
Types of Errors: -> 4 times request time out then the server is not available or the server using the firewall so it stops all the packets. -> If 1 and 3 packets got reply then Reasons for packet loss: Network congestion Faulty Hardware -> if all packets got Destination host unreachable then it is know as it was not connected to internet or there is no data in the server. -> if 3 packets loss then it High packet loss Resons for packet loss: Poor Network Issue Device Overload Routing Problem
